title: From Imitation to Reward Discovery: On-Policy Warmup for Agentic RL
abstract: arXiv:2609.39436v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Reinforcement learning with a verifiable reward (RLVR) offers a scalable approach to training language-model agents, yet sparse outcome rewards can leave early training with little signal for policy improvement. We identify an On-Policy Acceleration Phenomenon: in our main comparisons, RLVR initialized with on-policy distillation reaches high performance earlier in training and achieves both higher average performance during subsequent RLVR and higher final performance than the alternative baselines. Motivated by this observation, we study On-Policy Warmup (OPW), a teacher-guided stage in which the student trains with teacher supervision on its own interaction trajectories before transitioning to RLVR. Unlike imitation on fixed teacher-generated trajectories, OPW targets states induced by the student's own decisions, including imperfect actions and recovery situations. translated_title: 从模仿到奖励发现：面向智能体强化学习的在策略预热
translated_abstract: 基于可验证奖励的强化学习为训练语言模型智能体提供了一种可扩展的方法，然而稀疏的结果奖励使得训练早期几乎没有可用于策略改进的信号。我们识别出一种“在策略加速现象”：在我们的主要对比实验中，通过在策略蒸馏进行初始化的RLVR在训练过程中更早达到高性能，并且在后续的RLVR阶段中取得比其他基线更高的平均性能和更高的最终性能。受这一观察的启发，我们研究了在策略预热，这是一个由教师引导的阶段，学生在转换到RLVR之前，先在自己产生的交互轨迹上接受教师监督进行训练。与在固定的教师生成轨迹上进行模仿不同，OPW针对的是由学生自身决策所诱导的状态，包括不完美的动作和错误恢复的情形。我们通过将在策略反……（原文摘要此处截断）
tldr: 本文发现用在策略蒸馏初始化RLVR可显著加速训练，并提出在策略预热（OPW）方法——让学生在自身交互轨迹上接受教师监督后再进行RLVR，从而使智能体更早达到高性能并获得更高的最终性能。
